findings.title: gitignored build state that is a symlink — L003's named case — is never detected
while a state gap is open, every verify failure in that task is forgiven, including real defects
the repo's own orchid.config declares no verify_class signature, so T014's stale-pin hand-off still charges an attempt
infra_failures is charged before the testing→rework edge is known to exist, so a refused advance still spends environment budget
